name: Pailhead
lede: Pailhead was Ian MacKaye singing over Ministry's Al Jourgensen, Paul Barker and Bill Rieflin, on Wax Trax! in 1987 and 1988. A handful of singles, the Trait EP, and that was it.

facts.h: Jourgensen was nervous about the straight-edge icon
facts.p: He and MacKaye met in a London studio in 1986. From Jourgensen's memoir: "I was a little nervous about working with Ian, who is this real straight-edge icon."

src.title: An unlikely collaboration produced Pailhead's ferocious "I Will Refuse" (The A.V. Club)

facts.h: Chris Connelly sang "I Will Refuse" first
facts.p: MacKaye's vocal replaced his. Connelly, in his own memoir: "It was an honor to be erased by Ian."

src.title: An unlikely collaboration produced Pailhead's ferocious "I Will Refuse" (The A.V. Club)

facts.h: Three singles in about a year, then Trait
facts.p: "I Will Refuse" b/w "No Bunny" came out in 1987, "Don't Stand In Line" and "Man Should Surrender" in 1988. Naked Raygun drummer Eric Spicer is in the lineup too.
